notes.title: Monday - Small UI update
notes.content:
Hey guys, based on your comments in the community hud we made a small UI change and now you can see where you collected a golden wolf or a easter bunny. 
 So you don't have to keep looking for them in that especific level.

Also, we removed the easter rule to show the easter bunnies, so now you can collect them and get the achievement all the time, not just during easters.

Cheers,
GreatCogs Team.

notes.title: August Update!
notes.content:
Hey Guy, we have been listening to you and we decided to update the game.
 We fixed a few bugs and we changed the controls of the game, now you can use AWSD or JIKL or the arrows to controls the user.
 
As you know and you read in the forums using the arrows is not suggested by us because depending on the keyboard that you have it will let you press two arrows and space and the same time and you need to be able to move in diagonal in the sky level. So the UI will not suggest you to use arrows in game, you can do it, it depends on you.

Also, now you can control the entire menu with the keyboard or the gamepad, you don't need to use the mouse if you want.

Cheers,
Great Cogs Team.

notes.title: Our first month full of surprises!!
notes.content:
Hi!
 Here we are with big news!

We just released an update of the game, this update brings russian and german as possible languages and the most important... drum please... TRADING CARDS!! 
 Yep, now you are going to here unique trading cards, badges, icons and cards while you are playing the game.

Cheers,
Great Cogs team.

notes.title: Easter is over but NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hi guys, the easter weekend was awesome. We hope that you enjoyed the easter version of the game. 
 
We just released a new version that add a new language

[b] French [/b]

Also, we have been reading a lot of comments that you made and we added some new stuff to the game that you claimed in the forums.

This new version also has [b]checkpoints[/b] in some important places of the game, so if you die you don't have to start all over again. 
 We fixed a few little bugs.
And also we introduced new feedback for some of the traps.

We are working really hard for the next release that will be awesome!!

Cheers,
GreatCogs team

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - More Languages!!!
notes.content:
Hello friends, we are glad to inform that we uploaded a new version of the game.
 This new version added the possibility of changing the language.

The available languages are:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] Danish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Swedish
[/list]

We know how wonderful is to play a game in your own language so we will be adding more and more languages to the game.

Cheers,
GreatCogs Team.
